visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a red and white horizontal striped tank top, is seated at a dark wooden table. Behind her is a brown leather couch featuring a cushion with a beagle's face and a red cushion with white "aotter" text. The room has bright, even indoor lighting. She speaks expressively, pointing her finger and changing facial expressions to emphasize her points. (2) A white screen overlay appears showing a chronological list of iPhone models from 2008 to 2020. This is followed by a high-resolution graphic showcasing four iPhone 8 models in red, silver, gold, and space gray. The woman then holds up a silver smartphone with a floral-patterned case, displaying a technical specification webpage for the iPhone X on its screen. (3) The scene transitions to a classic oil painting portrait of Ludwig van Beethoven. This image is suddenly replaced by a grayscale version where his eyes are closed and a pink, cartoonish tongue sticks out. The woman returns to the frame, holding her phone and gesturing towards it while smiling. Purple variety text with a glowing border appears at the bottom of the screen as she concludes her talk.
